description: Related content organized in tabs with keyboard navigation.

howToUse: Use it to split related content of the same page into parts that people see one at a time: Overview, Activity, Settings.
Keep the labels short, in two or three words, and start with the tab most people need.
Use `variant="pill"` inside cards and panels, and `wrap` when the tabs do not fit on one line.
alternatives: Switching the view of the same data (list, grid): Segmented.
Going to another page of the app: NavigationMenu or Sidebar.

keyboard.action: Enters the tab list on the active tab, and the next Tab goes to the content.
Opens the previous or next tab. With `orientation="vertical"`, use `↑` or `↓`.
Opens the first or last tab.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets the tabs wrap onto lines when there is not enough width.
